data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Aleyah is derived from the Arabic root ‘alaya’, meaning ‘to be exalted’ or ‘sublime’. It is a name of honor and respect, often given to girls who are expected to uphold high moral standards and values. Aleyah is also associated with the concept of ‘al-‘aliyyat’ (the high and exalted) in Islamic theology, referring to the divine attributes of God.
